## Goals of this notebook

The steps we'll take to prepare our data:

- Download the data
- Import it into our notebook
- Clean up data types and columns
- Export the data for next notebook

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
```

## Importing

```{r}
special_ed_2025_employeelist_original <- read_excel(
 "data-original/R000124-082126-September_2025-Employee_List.xlsx"
)
```

```{r}
special_ed_2026_employeelist_original <- read_excel(
 "data-original/R000124-082126-September_2026_Employee_List.xlsx"
)
```

```{r}
special_ed_enrollment_original <- read_excel(
 "data-original/R000124-082126-SPED_Enrollment.xlsx"
)
```

## Cleaning names

```{r}
employeelist_2025_names <- special_ed_2025_employeelist_original |> 
  clean_names()

employeelist_2025_names |> glimpse()
```

```{r}
employeelist_2026_names <- special_ed_2026_employeelist_original |> 
  clean_names()

employeelist_2026_names |> glimpse()
```

```{r}
enrollment_numbers <- special_ed_enrollment_original |> 
  clean_names()

enrollment_numbers |> glimpse()
```

## Separation of Shutdown Schools

```{r}
shutdown_enrollment_numbers <- enrollment_numbers |> 
  mutate(
    school_active = case_when(
      is.na(x26_27) ~ "Closed",
      TRUE ~ "Open"
    ))

shutdown_enrollment_numbers
```

## Creating new columns to handle <10 Schools

```{r}
enrollment_number_10 <- shutdown_enrollment_numbers |>
  mutate(
    x2025_2026 = case_when(
      x25_26 < 10 ~ NA,
      is.na(x25_26) ~ 0,
      .default = as.numeric(x25_26)),
     x2026_2027 = case_when(
      x26_27 < 10 ~ NA,
      is.na(x26_27) ~ 0,
      .default = as.numeric(x26_27),
    )
  )

enrollment_number_10
```

## Make Separate Section for NA Rows

```{r}
na_rows_enrollment <- enrollment_number_10 |>
  filter(
    is.na(x2025_2026) | is.na(x2026_2027)
  )

na_rows_enrollment
```

## Remove NA Rows and Remove old columns

```{r}
removal_enrollment <- enrollment_number_10 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(x2025_2026),
    !is.na(x2026_2027)
  ) |>
  select(
    campus,
    school_active,
    x2025_2026,
    x2026_2027
  ) 
  
removal_enrollment
```


## Export

```{r}
removal_enrollment |>
   write_rds("data-processed/01-cleaning.rds")
```
